content:
Maya (SRE): Paging — alert: hosted-api (us-west-2) 5xx-rate > 1% over 5m, spike started ~10:12 UTC. Investigating.
Incident Bot: TRIGGERED: high-5xx-rate on hosted-api - us-west-2. Pager duty triggered: #oncall (Riley). Link: https://pager.redwood/INC-1723
Riley (oncall): Ack. Looking at routing layer first. Checking pool sizes and compile backlog. Running scale to warm pool now: `redwoodctl scale pool hosted-usw2-warm --replicas 8`
Josh (runtime): Seeing repeated compile errors for route-compiler service: `compile_job: failed to allocate KV cache (overflow)` — snippet:
```
ERROR route-compiler - alloc_kv_cache failed size=0x1a2f
stack: ...
```
Riley (oncall): Rolling a fallback for non-critical routes to `redwood/lite-v1` to reduce pressure. Applying routing override: `routes.override('/public/*') -> variant: redwood/lite-v1`
Priya (CS): Quick question — any customers definitely impacted (Dedicated vs Hosted)? Need list for outreach.
Riley (oncall): Initial impact: ~3 Hosted customers had elevated 503s by monitoring alerts. No Dedicated customers flagged so far. I'll create a CS bridging note and prepare a statuspage draft. @Priya please review the short customer notice below.
Priya (CS): Copy for CS outreach (draft):
"Hi — we observed intermittent 5xx errors for the Hosted API in us-west-2 between 10:12–10:42 UTC. Mitigations have been applied and traffic is back to normal. We're preparing a follow-up with root cause and any credits if needed. — Priya, Redwood CS"
Statuspage Bot: POSTED: "Partial Service Disruption: Hosted API (us-west-2) — Investigating" — https://status.redwood/incident/1735550001
Maya (SRE): Mitigation progress: forced KV cache eviction + restart of route-compiler workers. Error rate dropped to 0.22% over the last 5m. Continuing to watch for regressions.
Riley (oncall): On-call handoff planned in 30m to Josh. Creating immediate follow-ups: 1) RCA + timeline, 2) customer follow-up drafts, 3) increase warm-pool targets, 4) add route-compiler regression test to CI.
Priya (CS): I'll post the statuspage update and start targeted outreach to the 3 affected customers with the draft. Also prepping a credit proposal if they request.
Josh (runtime): Acknowledged handoff. I'll keep monitors for 4h and then hand to infra night shift. Also filing a bug for KV cache TTL heuristic.
Maya (SRE): Preliminary root cause hypothesis: routing-compiler backlog combined with tokenization length spike caused excessive KV cache retention and warm-pool depletion during a traffic burst. Short-term preventatives: bump warm pool to 12 replicas, add emergency routing fallback thresholds. Long-term: TTL on KV cache + compile queue throttling.
Priya (CS): Final customer note going out in 15m with timeline + mitigation steps. Will attach monitoring screenshots and offer 5% service credit for affected windows pending legal sign-off.
Incident Bot: RESOLVED: alert condition cleared. All checks nominal. Marking incident as resolved — please file postmortem.
Statuspage Bot: UPDATED: "Resolved — Hosted API (us-west-2) back to normal" — https://status.redwood/incident/1735550001
Riley (oncall): Closing action items in tracker: /tasks create "RCA - routing compile KV cache incident" assignee=Josh due=3d; /tasks create "Add route-compiler regression test" assignee=Maya due=7d; /tasks create "CS customer follow-up & credits" assignee=Priya due=2d
Josh (runtime): Will draft RCA and include timeline + logs. Expect first draft by EOD.
Priya (CS): Thanks team. Once the RCA is out I'll send the post-incident customer email and update any committed credits. :white_check_mark:
Maya (SRE): Note for postmortem: collect `route-compiler` logs between 10:05–10:50 UTC, warm-pool metrics, and tokenization size distribution for affected requests.
Priya (CS): Posting final customer message now: https://docs.redwood/drafts/cs/1735550001-draft
Riley (oncall): Handing off to Josh now. Logging off.
Josh (runtime): Taking over monitoring. Will post RCA link when ready.
Incident Bot: Post-incident: scheduled postmortem meeting on calendar — 2026-03-18 16:00 UTC. Reminder will be sent.
